articles.title: Israel says it killed a top Hamas commander, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Israeli forces have killed a top Hamas commander in an airstrike on southern Gaza. The Israeli military says the commander was involved in planning terror attacks. Meanwhile, Iran’s Revolutionary Guard claimed on Sunday that it struck a radar system at an American base in Bahrain. The U.S. military has not commented on the claim. In Yemen, Houthi health officials report an airstrike on Sanaa, Yemen's capital, wounded two women and two children. They blame Saudi Arabia for the attack. The Saudi military says it intercepted missiles and drones fired by the Houthis. Tensions continue to escalate in the region.
